enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping through the night with the fan on low for white noise, phone on silent to protect rest
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Bend knees. Stretch right arm. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Move legs. Turn onto back. Sigh. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and changing into clean clothes for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Stand and walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe face with towel. Remove pajamas. Put on clean clothes. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a flexitarian breakfast of oats, toast and tea, then packing a lunch container and refilling a water bottle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open fridge and take out oats, bread, milk, butter. Close fridge. Take out bowl, plate, mug, spoon, knife. Pour oats into bowl. Add milk to oats. Place bowl in microwave and turn on. Put bread in toaster and press lever. Fill kettle with water and turn on. Pour boiling water into mug and add tea bag. Remove tea bag after steeping. Take out bowl from microwave. Take out toast from toaster. Spread butter on toast. Sit at table. Eat oats. Eat toast. Drink tea. Wash dishes. Pack lunch: open fridge, take out food, put in container, close container, put in bag. Refill water bottle at tap. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by train and bus from Clayton to the Monash University campus, reading course notes on the way
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to train station. Wait for train. Board train. Sit down. Take out course notes. Read notes. Look up at station. Get off train. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Sit down. Continue reading notes. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to campus. Enter campus. Walk to lecture hall.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending second-year Master of Social Work lectures and tutorials, taking detailed handwritten notes and writing down assignment deadlines
enriched_activities.desc: Enter lecture hall. Sit at desk. Take out notebook and pen. Listen to lecture. Write notes. Raise hand to ask question. Write down assignment deadline. Turn page. Underline key points. Take break, stand up, stretch. Walk to tutorial room. Sit down. Participate in discussion. Write more notes. Check time. Pack up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating the packed lunch on campus and reviewing notes for the afternoon placement shift
enriched_activities.desc: Find a seat. Open bag. Take out lunch container. Open container. Take out utensils. Eat lunch. Drink water from bottle. Close container. Put container back in bag. Take out notes. Review notes. Highlight important points. Close notes. Put notes away. Stand up. Throw away trash. Walk to next location.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by bus and train to the aged-care facility for the afternoon support shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to train station. Wait for train. Board train. Sit down. Look out window. Get off train. Walk to aged-care facility. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working a part-time aged-care support shift, assisting residents with meals, mobility, personal care and social activity programs
enriched_activities.desc: Clock in at staff room. Attend handover meeting. Review resident care plans. Assist resident with breakfast. Help resident with walking to activity room. Assist resident with toileting. Change bed linen. Serve morning tea. Lead a group exercise session. Assist resident with lunch. Help resident with mobility transfer from chair to bed. Provide personal care (showering, dressing). Organize social activity (bingo). Assist resident with afternoon tea. Document care provided. Attend afternoon handover. Clock out. Walk to bus stop.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home by train and bus after the shift, checking text messages on the way
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Sit down. Take out phone. Open messaging app. Read text messages. Reply to text messages. Put phone away. Get off bus. Walk to train station. Wait for train. Board train. Sit down. Check phone again. Get off train. Walk home. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Reheating a simple flexitarian dinner, eating it and washing up the dishes and containers
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open fridge. Take out dinner container. Close fridge. Open container. Place container in microwave. Turn on microwave. Wait. Take out container. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Wash dishes and containers. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Writing up placement reflections on the computer and updating the weekly budget notes and reminder list at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedroom light. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Log in. Open word processor. Write placement reflections. Save document. Open spreadsheet. Update budget notes. Open reminder app. Update reminder list. Close computer. Turn off desk lamp. Turn off bedroom light. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering, washing up and setting out clothes and bag for the next day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Put on pajamas. Set out clothes for next day. Pack bag. Turn off bathroom light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Drinking a cup of tea and sending written text messages to housemates about the weekend house meeting agenda
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on bed. Pick up cup. Sip tea. Put cup down. Pick up phone. Open messaging app. Type message: 'What time works for the house meeting this weekend?'. Send message. Wait for reply. Sip tea again. Reply to message: 'Saturday 10am works for me.'. Put phone down. Finish tea. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Dimming the light, putting the phone on charge and settling into sleep with the fan on low
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Dim light. Turn on fan to low. Plug phone into charger. Place phone on bedside table. Lie in bed. Close eyes. Pull blanket. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Breathe deeply. Turn to other side. Stretch. Remain asleep.
